card.name: Words introducing a condition about the person
card.fires_on: Words like "if", "because" and "consider" right before a clause about what someone is or has, such as "if you have" or "considered himself".

modes.label: Conditional if
modes.description: "if" opening a condition about the reader or patient, as in warnings and contraindications.
modes.example: Avoid use<< if>> you have an allergy to citrus or bio

modes.label: Self-description verbs
modes.description: Verbs like consider or describe, followed by a reflexive or identity phrase.
modes.example: but never<< considered>> himself a radical or innovator.

modes.label: Because they are
modes.example: Women are often the victims of violence simply<< because>> they are women.

card.writes: It promotes words meaning "I am", "you are", "he is" and "himself" (mostly Chinese), pushing the next words toward a statement of identity.
card.plain: It fires on a word that is about to say what someone is or considers themselves to be.
evidence: but never<< considered>> himself a radical or innovator.
